description.value: Sandy's Bake Shoppe is a scratch bakery and café founded in 2018 by co-owners Sandy Bryhn and Adam Townsend, who bring over 16 years of combined culinary experience on BC's Sunshine Coast. The shop produces a full range of traditional baked goods — breads, pastries, tarts, cakes — alongside savory lunch items including soups, wraps, and sandwiches made on their own house-baked breads. Special orders and catering, including wedding cakes, are available by arrangement.
